claims.text: What the image looks like Diffuse 1-3 mm “millet seed” nodules → miliary TB (hematogenous)
claims.quote: Diffuse 1-3 mm 'millet seed' nodules Miliary TB (hematogenous)

claims.text: Merck: the CXR shows thousands of 2- to 3-mm interstitial nodules evenly distributed thru both lungs
claims.quote: in miliary TB, it shows thousands of 2- to 3-mm interstitial nodules evenly distributed through both lungs.

claims.text: Eti A severe, potentially fatal form of TB: a tuberculous lesion erodes into a blood vessel and seeds millions of bacilli thru the bloodstream and the body
claims.quote: Miliary TB is a severe, potentially fatal form of M. tuberculosis infection (1). Also known as generalized hematogenous TB, miliary TB develops when a tuberculous lesion erodes into a blood vessel, disseminating millions of tubercle bacilli into the bloodstream and throughout the body.

claims.text: MC among children < 4 y/o, immunocompromised people (esp w HIV) and older adults
claims.quote: Miliary TB is most common among: Children < 4 years old Immunocompromised people (especially those with HIV infection) Older adults

claims.text: Sx Fever, chills, weakness, malaise, wt loss and often progress dyspnea; intermittent seeding can cause a prolonged fever of unknown origin
claims.quote: Symptoms of miliary TB include fever, chills, weakness, malaise, weight loss, and often progressive dyspnea. Intermittent dissemination of tubercle bacilli may lead to a prolonged fever of unknown origin (FUO).

claims.text: Untx w IS, it often progresses rapidly to resp failure or ARDS and multi-organ dysfun
claims.quote: In untreated patients with miliary TB and immunosuppression, disease often progresses rapidly to acute respiratory failure or acute respiratory distress syndrome (ARDS) and multi-organ dysfunction; mortality can consequently be high.

claims.text: Tx and next step Her chart: same as active TB; consider HIV testing
claims.quote: Same as active TB; consider HIV testing

claims.text: Extrapulm TB = treated w combinations of antimicrobials for ± 6 months
claims.quote: Treatment is with combinations of antimicrobials for a duration of at least 6 months.
